model_slots.label: Retrieval
model_slots.note: Shares the generic @embed role with every other retrieval rail. Embedders are out of the Admin -> Rails panel's scope by design, so there is no RAIL_MODEL_SLOTS counterpart.

notes: Serves a richer /api/capabilities rather than /api/models because the UI also renders corpus size, collection count and voice backend. The models[] portion of that payload still obeys the model-status envelope.
The shell draws a real Gemini spark SVG for this rail via iconOverrides; the emoji here is only the catalog fallback.
Holds the answer model resident and uses /v1/tts_light (Kokoro) so speech never evicts it.
